messages:
alex: Quick check — vendor flagged \"OOM on quiet window\" for eu-west1 H100 batch pools. Can someone confirm if we have spare A100/H100 slots tonight? Need ~4 GPUs for nightly evals (00:00-03:00 UTC). Tagging @priya @jamal

priya: @alex which pool? dedicated-demo or burst-demo? H100 preferred, but can do A100 if latency's fine.

alex: burst-demo. If vendor can't confirm, we can failover to dedicated-demo (higher cost). Also saw these errors in telemetry: \"oom_kv_cache\" spikes around 23:50 UTC.

jamal: putting telemetry snippet — run this to see eviction OOMs:
```
curl -s https://telemetry.internal/api/v1/metrics?query=oom_kv_cache%7Bregion%3D%22eu-west1%22%7D | jq .
```

sophie: FYI vendor-paul said backlog ETA ~48-72h on H100s, but they might have 2 spare in eu-west for immediate borrow. He asked for manifest + tenant ID.

alex: ok can we reserve 4 (prefer H100x2 + A100x2) for 00:00-03:00? I can supply manifest. What's the tenant ID format?

vendor-paul: vendor here — send tenant as `redwood-demo-<shorthash>`. We can tentatively hold 2 H100 for 3 hours if you confirm by 22:00 UTC. Need billing code and manifest.

priya: I’ll open a quick procurement ticket. billing code RED-TEST-42. Alex, paste manifest here and I'll ping vendor.

alex: manifest pasted:
```
tenant: redwood-demo-7b2
workload: nightly-evals
start: 2026-03-22T00:00Z
duration: 3h
gpu_mix: 2xH100,2xA100
slo: latency<=80ms p90
```

jamal: suggest we also flip KV cache throttling for eval cluster to avoid OOM:
`infractl apply --cluster evals --patch '{\"kv_cache\":{\"max_entries\":500000}}'` quick rollback plan ready.

sophie: sounds good. @capacity-bot can you mark tentative hold in capacity calendar?

capacity-bot: Tentative hold created for 2026-03-22 00:00-03:00 UTC — 2 H100s + 2 A100s (eu-west1). Hold expires 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC if not confirmed.

alex: thanks team. Priya, once procurement ticket is up, can you assign to me to confirm with vendor? I'll confirm by 21:30 UTC.

priya: will do. created ticket PROJ-8769 and assigned to @alex. :thumbsup: 

vendor-paul: holding will be released if no confirm by 22:00. Ping me in DM if you need to extend.

jamal: quick CR ping — I left a small note on the infra repo re: the KV cache patch. pls lgtm if you want the change tonight.

alex: ack, I'll review in 30m.
